items.q: Yeah. He wanted me to listen to it. And I listened to it. And I says, 'Okay, give it here.' 'I'll put the verse to it.'

ctx.x: No kidding. And so what did he -- I mean did he say to you, 'I've got something here. Do you want to put something to it?' Or --
Yeah. He wanted me to listen to it. And I listened to it. And I says, 'Okay, give it here.' 'I'll put the verse to it.'
